title: Introduction
description: An overview of AdonisJS and the design principles behind it.

title: Pick your path
description: Understand AdonisJS's approach to frontend development and choose between Hypermedia, Inertia, and API-only stacks for your application.

title: Installation
description: Learn how to create a new AdonisJS application and start the development server.

title: Folder structure
description: Understand the default folder structure of an AdonisJS application and the role of each file and directory.

title: Development environment setup
description: Learn how to configure an efficient development environment for building applications with AdonisJS.

title: Configuration & Environment
description: Learn how to manage configuration and environment variables in AdonisJS applications with type-safe validation.

title: Deployment
description: Learn how to build and deploy AdonisJS applications to production, including creating standalone builds and configuring production environments.

title: FAQs
description: Quick answers to the most common questions about AdonisJS, including framework sustainability, technical capabilities, and production readiness.

title: Overview (Hypermedia)
description: Build a fully functional community showcase website with AdonisJS and learn how to create hypermedia-driven web applications.

title: Overview (React)
description: Build a fully functional community showcase website with AdonisJS, Inertia, and React, and learn how to create modern full-stack web applications.

title: Commandline and REPL (Hypermedia)
description: Learn to use the AdonisJS Ace CLI and REPL to generate files and interact with your application during the DevShow tutorial.

title: Commandline and REPL (React)
description: Learn to use the AdonisJS Ace CLI and REPL to generate files and interact with your application during the DevShow React tutorial.

title: Database and models (Hypermedia)
description: Create models and database migrations for the DevShow tutorial application, define relationships, and seed test data using factories.

title: Database and models (React)
description: Create models and database migrations for the DevShow React tutorial application, define relationships, and seed test data using factories.

title: Routes, controllers and views (Hypermedia)
description: Build routes, controllers, and Edge template views for the DevShow tutorial application to display posts and comments.

title: Routes, controllers and views (React)
description: Build routes, controllers, and React views using Inertia for the DevShow tutorial application to display posts and comments.

title: Forms and validation (Hypermedia)
description: Add form handling and validation to the DevShow tutorial application to allow users to create posts and comments.

title: Forms and validation (React)
description: Add form handling and validation to the DevShow React tutorial application to allow users to create posts and comments using Inertia forms.

title: Styling and cleanup (Hypermedia)
description: Style and improve the user experience of the DevShow tutorial application by adding navigation, CSS, and visual polish.

title: Styling and cleanup (React)
description: Style and improve the user experience of the DevShow React tutorial application by adding navigation, CSS, and visual polish.

title: Authorization (Hypermedia)
description: Add authorization to the DevShow tutorial application using AdonisJS Bouncer policies to restrict editing and deleting of posts and comments.

title: Authorization (React)
description: Add authorization to the DevShow React tutorial application using AdonisJS Bouncer policies to restrict editing and deleting of posts and comments.

title: Contributing
description: Contributing to AdonisJS projects is a great way to give back to the community. This guide provides a general overview of how you can contribute to any AdonisJS project.

title: Releases
description: AdonisJS release history and changelog, including new features, bug fixes, and breaking changes.

title: Governance
description: Governance model for the AdonisJS project, outlining roles, responsibilities, and decision-making processes.

title: Routing
description: Define URL patterns, handle dynamic routes, create resource routes, and use the type-safe URL builder for navigation.

title: Controllers
description: Learn how to create and use controllers to organize your route handlers in AdonisJS applications.

title: HTTP context
description: Learn about the HTTP context object in AdonisJS and how to access request-specific data and services.

title: Middleware
description: Learn how to use and create middleware in AdonisJS to handle cross-cutting concerns during HTTP requests.

title: Request
description: Learn how to work with HTTP requests in AdonisJS, including reading request data, headers, cookies, and handling trusted proxies.

title: Response
description: Learn how to construct HTTP responses in AdonisJS, including sending different response formats, headers, cookies, redirects, and file downloads.

title: Body parser
description: Learn how to configure the body parser to handle JSON, form data, and file uploads in AdonisJS applications.

title: Validation
description: Learn how to validate user input in AdonisJS using VineJS validators at the controller level.

title: File uploads
description: Learn how to handle file uploads in AdonisJS, from basic single file uploads to advanced direct uploads with cloud storage providers.

title: Session
description: Learn how to use sessions to persist state across HTTP requests in AdonisJS applications.

title: URL builder
description: Learn how to generate type-safe URLs for named routes in templates, redirects, and frontend applications.

title: Exception handling
description: Learn how to handle and report exceptions during HTTP requests in AdonisJS applications.

title: Debugging
description: Learn how to debug AdonisJS applications using VSCode, Node.js inspector, debug logs, and Edge template helpers.

title: Static file server
description: Learn how to serve static files from the public directory using the @adonisjs/static package.

title: EdgeJS
description: Learn how to use Edge templates in AdonisJS applications to render HTML on the server-side.

title: Inertia
description: Learn how to build modern single-page applications using Inertia with AdonisJS, React, and Vue.

title: Transformers
description: Learn how to transform and serialize data in AdonisJS applications, including converting models to JSON and generating TypeScript types for frontend use.

description: Learn how to use Tuyau, a type-safe HTTP client for AdonisJS applications that enables end-to-end type safety between backend and frontend.

title: TanStack query
description: Learn how to integrate TanStack Query with Tuyau for type-safe API calls, infinite scrolling, and cache management in AdonisJS applications.

title: Vite
description: Learn how to use Vite to bundle frontend assets in AdonisJS applications.

title: SQL ORM
description: Learn how to use Lucid ORM, the official SQL ORM for AdonisJS, including models, query builder, migrations, and relationships.

title: Redis
description: Use Redis inside your AdonisJS applications using the @adonisjs/redis package.

title: Introduction
description: Learn about the authentication system in AdonisJS and how to authenticate users in your application.

description: Learn how to securely verify user credentials in an AdonisJS application using the AuthFinder mixin.

title: Session guard
description: Learn how to authenticate users using the session guard in AdonisJS.

description: Learn how to authenticate HTTP requests using opaque access tokens in AdonisJS.

description: Learn how to authenticate HTTP requests using the HTTP Basic Authentication protocol in AdonisJS.

description: Learn how to create a custom authentication guard for AdonisJS.

description: Implement social authentication in your AdonisJS applications using the @adonisjs/ally package.

description: Learn how to implement authorization in AdonisJS using abilities and policies with the Bouncer package.

title: Hashing
description: Learn how to securely hash and verify passwords using the AdonisJS hash service.

title: Encryption
description: Learn how to encrypt and decrypt sensitive data in your AdonisJS applications.

title: CORS
description: Learn how to implement CORS in AdonisJS to control cross-origin access to your API.

title: Securing SSR apps
description: Learn how to protect your server-rendered applications from common web attacks using the @adonisjs/shield package.

title: Rate limiting
description: Protect your web application or API server from abuse by implementing rate limits using the @adonisjs/limiter package.

description: Learn about the application lifecycle in AdonisJS, including the boot, start, and termination phases.

description: Learn how dependency injection works in AdonisJS and how to use the IoC container to manage class dependencies automatically.

title: Service providers
description: Learn about service providers in AdonisJS and how to use lifecycle hooks to execute code during application startup and shutdown.

description: Learn about container services in AdonisJS and how they provide convenient access to framework components through ES module imports.

title: Barrel files
description: Understand what barrel files are, why AdonisJS uses them, and how they help reduce visual clutter in your codebase.

description: Learn how to use Assembler hooks to run custom actions during the development, testing, and build lifecycle of your AdonisJS application.

description: Learn how to extend the AdonisJS framework using macros and getters.

description: Learn how to add health checks to your AdonisJS application for monitoring liveness and readiness in production environments.

description: Learn how to create web apps for multiple regions and languages using the @adonisjs/i18n package.

description: Learn how to use atomic locks in AdonisJS to prevent race conditions and coordinate concurrent operations.

description: Learn how to create custom Ace commands in AdonisJS

description: Learn about defining and processing command arguments in Ace commands.

description: Learn how to define and process command flags in Ace commands.
